A video game clip takes center stage in this short segment from Joe Rogan Experience episode 397. Rogan watches a Grand Theft Auto V scene edited to mimic a DMT trip. The early show often mixed drug talk with pop culture, and this bit is a pure example.

As the warped gameplay rolls, Rogan reacts to the fractals and melting shapes on screen. He compares the digital visuals with real psychedelic reports he has heard and given over the years. The guest joins in on whether games can echo an altered state. It is a light, curious moment from the podcast's younger years.
